firebase_foundation_enabled.description: Reserved for gradual client foundation rollout. It does not enable Firestore, Storage, or App Check enforcement.

app_check_enforcement_enabled.description: Informational only until physical-provider registration and server enforcement are reviewed.

ai_clara_enabled.description: Enables only the server-side CLARA OpenAI provider path after staging smoke tests and signed-device App Check proof.

ai_challenges_enabled.description: Enables only the server-side challenge-generation OpenAI provider path after staging smoke tests and signed-device App Check proof.

ai_retention_enabled.description: Enables only the server-side retention-plan OpenAI provider path after staging smoke tests and signed-device App Check proof.

remote_notifications_enabled.description: Enables server-side reviewed remote notification dispatch only after staging signed-device FCM/APNs proof.
